title: Emergency Supply While a Coverage Review Is Pending — Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit Desk Guidance
content:
**Rule.** Under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, an emergency supply is granted only while a coverage review for that drug is pending, at most the network's number of emergency supply overrides per drug per plan year, and the days it allows are the review bridge.

- The review bridge is for the drug of the member's most recently opened coverage review case, and it is recorded against the prescription number of the member's most recent paid network claim for that drug.
- The review bridge is not worked out until every paper claim filed on the benefit for the drug under review carries its decision.

Put another way, while any paper claim on the benefit for the drug under review still carries neither an approval nor a denial, the review bridge has no figure yet.

## What the grant does

The emergency supply is an override that lets a network pharmacy dispense a bridge supply of the prescription while the coverage review is still undecided. It is recorded today against the prescription number given, for the drug of the member's paid claims on that prescription, allows the number of days given, and can be used by the pharmacy through the seventh calendar day from today. On success the member can fill the bridge supply at a network pharmacy.

## Tool reference: `grant_review_bridge_supply_635c815d`

**Owner and invocation.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `grant_review_bridge_supply_635c815d` and calls it on the member's verified account.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `retail_benefit_id` | The reference number of the member's Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, read from the member's retail benefit record | Identifier, as on record |
| `rx_number` | The prescription number exactly as it appears on the member's paid claim records for the drug | Verbatim, copied character for character with no normalisation, addition or deletion |
| `days_supply_allowed` | The bridge supply the override permits | Whole number of days |

**Return.** On success: `status` ("granted" when the override was recorded); `override_id` (the reference number of the override); `override_type` ("emergency_supply"); `drug_name` (the drug the override applies to); `rx_number`; `days_supply_allowed` (whole days); and `valid_through_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the last day a pharmacy may use it).

## Questions on the entry

- **Which drug is the bridge for?** The drug of the member's most recently opened coverage review case.
- **Against which prescription number is it recorded?** The prescription number of the member's most recent paid network claim for that drug.
- **Can a bridge be granted after the review has been decided?** No. An emergency supply is granted only while the coverage review for that drug is pending, that is, while the review case is still awaiting decision.
